CONGA is a new network-based load balancing scheme that is able to achieve the best of both worlds: it is nearly as effective at load balancing as centralized schedulers, but can react to congestion in the order of microseconds.

the datacenter network is a critical part of the datacenter fabric that needs to be jointly designed with the rest of the fabric to achieve good performance.
